mastery_task.scenario_en: A fictional club member leaves a contact voice message.
mastery_task.scenario_ar: عضو خيالي في نادٍ يترك رسالة ببيانات التواصل.
mastery_task.prompt_en: Record the name, age, phone number, and available day from the message.
mastery_task.support: Two full plays and blank labels only; no transcript, digits, or answer-bearing waveform.
mastery_task.freshness: All details, voice, grouping, teen/ty contrast, and day differ from practice.

replacement_mastery_task.scenario_en: A fictional course applicant leaves changed contact details.
replacement_mastery_task.scenario_ar: متقدم خيالي لدورة يترك بيانات مختلفة.
replacement_mastery_task.prompt_en: Capture the new name, age, phone number, and day accurately.
replacement_mastery_task.support: Two full plays and blank labels only; no transcript, digits, or answer-bearing waveform.
replacement_mastery_task.freshness: New speaker, values, grouping, and day preserve the construct without repeating answers.

rubric.level_2: Each heard detail is assigned to the correct field.
Name, age, every phone digit, and day are accurate.
Changed grouping and a new teen/ty value are handled without a transcript.
Uncertain key detail is replayed or checked rather than guessed.

decision.demonstrated: Level 2 or above on every required dimension.
decision.needs_review: Any required dimension below level 2; use targeted practice and a new task.
decision.completion_rule: Opening sections or finishing exercises never grants mastery.

teach_back_variant.prompt_ar: اشرح الفرق بين تسجيل رقم هاتف وفهم عدد مثل forty-two، واذكر طريقة تأكد واحدة.

omit_variant.content: Proceed directly to the matched close and review card.

delayed_review.task: Capture a changed phone number and day.
Distinguish a new teen/ty age pair.
Capture all four fields from a new voice message.
